name: scroll-fade
title: Scroll Fade
description: A scrolling list wrapper that masks its own top and bottom edges and gently scales and blurs rows as they approach the hidden edge, so cut-off content tapers away instead of being sharply clipped.
use: A fixed-height list or panel scrolls but hard edges make the cut-off rows look abrupt and unfinished.
avoid: It edits child inline styles for scale and blur, so virtualized lists or already-transformed children can conflict.
a11y: Reduced-motion is honoured, but the scroll box is not focusable, so keyboard users must reach a child before arrowing through it. (keyboard: partial, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A rounded bordered card with a small header row showing 'Changelog' and a release count, above a tall scroll area. Inside, one line per release: a monospaced version, a title, and a date or small pill. Rows near a scrolled edge fade and shrink.
behaves: On scroll the wrapper measures how near it is to each end and fades that edge with a gradient mask; rows inside the fade zone also shrink slightly and blur. An edge with nothing hidden stays fully opaque, and values settle with a short animation.
customise: Orientation, fade size, shrink amount, blur strength, transition and an enabled flag are props; the gradient maths and edge colours are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: Observes scroll, resize and DOM mutations and repaints item scale and blur on each frame.
